precepts.point: So the Lord is speaking of Christ here, and what is being revealed in the same breath is who Solomon was.

precepts.text: Wisdom teaches fortitude, the very strength and courage the Lord commanded Joshua to have.
precepts.point: It takes strength to observe to do according to all the law; that is why the scriptures speak of building up your faith and being exercised in the things you learn. You have to be spiritually fit to survive in this truth, especially as a leader. The word for being strong and very courageous is fortitude, one of the virtues that comes with wisdom.

note.label: Joshua 1: The Charge to Joshua and the Formula for Success

precepts.why:
The first thing the Lord commands the new leader is to be strong and of a good courage, and he has to reiterate it: “Only be thou strong and very courageous”. The word for being strong and very courageous is fortitude, and Solomon names it among the virtues that come with wisdom: “And if a man love righteousness her labours are virtues: for she teacheth temperance and prudence, justice and fortitude: which are such things, as men can have nothing more profitable in their life.”

Wisdom teaches fortitude, the very strength and courage the Lord commanded Joshua to have. This truth is not for the weak, not for people easily discouraged when trials and tribulations occur and people bring burdens of matters unto you; you have to be built for it. You are dealing with the Israelites, a stiffnecked, rebellious, cold hearted people, so there is no room for mild moments or weak moments.

It takes strength to “observe to do according to all the law”; that is why the scriptures speak of building up your faith and being exercised in the things you learn. You have to be spiritually fit to survive in this truth, especially as a leader.

precepts.text: The chapter speaks of wisdom as a she who orders all things sweetly and mightily.
precepts.point: Solomon shows what a companion meditation makes of wisdom: when he came into his house he reposed himself with her, for her conversation has no bitterness and living with her has no sorrow, but mirth and joy. Get in the habit of chilling with wisdom when you get home. When you ponder the whole benefit package that comes with wisdom, you understand that to be allied unto wisdom is immortality; the wiser you get, the more spiritually invincible you become.

note.label: Joshua 1: The Charge to Joshua and the Formula for Success

precepts.why:
“Wisdom reacheth from one end to another mightily: and sweetly doth she order all things.” The chapter speaks of wisdom as a she, who orders all things sweetly and mightily.

Solomon goes on in this chapter to show what a companion meditation makes of that wisdom, when a man comes into his house and reposes himself with her. Wisdom that reaches from one end to another mightily is what meditating in the law day and night gives you.

precepts.why:
Solomon shows what a companion meditation makes of wisdom: “After I am come into mine house, I will repose myself with her: for her conversation hath no bitterness; and to live with her hath no sorrow, but mirth and joy.” Get in the habit of chilling with wisdom when you get home. Her conversation has no bitterness and living with her has no sorrow, but mirth and joy.

“Now when I considered these things in myself, and pondered them in my heart, how that to be allied unto wisdom is immortality”. Solomon pondered these things in his heart; that pondering is the meditation the Lord commanded Joshua. When you ponder the whole benefit package that comes with wisdom, you understand that to be allied unto wisdom is immortality; the wiser you get, the more spiritually invincible you become.

You can’t prove who all the tribes are throughout the world; you’re right, we don’t know. Families travel; men went to Vietnam and had babies there, and West Indians intermarried in Panama. It is impossible for us as men to determine who’s who, but there is a God. “I shall set the people in order”: whatever we got wrong, whatever we don’t know, the Lord is going to set the people in order. That’s going to be done in the wilderness.

moments.label: Escape Thankskilling : Oh God & My Lord

points: And if a man love righteousness, her labours are virtues: for she teacheth temperance and prudence, justice and fortitude: which are such things, as men can have nothing more profitable in their life. There is nothing more profitable in your life, brothers and sisters, than righteousness, justice and fortitude. There is nothing more worthwhile in life.

For I was a witty child, and had a good spirit. King Solomon said something very important. He said he was a witty child. He had good wits about him and he had a good spirit. And that is from the time of childhood. We just read in Sirach that wisdom is with the faithful in the womb. Now King Solomon is going in depth, saying that when he was a child, meaning after birth, he was witty, meaning he was quick, he was sharp, he had understanding. Despite your mechanical skills taking a little longer than other children, some had to get those specialised shoes so they could walk.

Yea rather, being good, I came into a body undefiled. So now King Solomon deals with both himself and then he begins to get prophetic as he comes back as Christ. That is the body undefiled he is talking about. In the space of two verses he deals with himself and then goes future tense as Christ.

Nevertheless, when I perceived that I could not otherwise obtain her, except God gave her me; and that was a point of wisdom also to know whose gift she was; I prayed unto the Lord, and besought him, and with my whole heart I said. When he realised that he could not obtain her, being wisdom, by any other means except God gave her to him.

There are some in the scriptures that tried to buy the spirit of God, the Holy Spirit. They requested it, lied and cheated, even trying to obtain that spirit from God. There is nothing you can do except the Lord himself give it to you. You have to pray, you have to fast, you have to study, and the Lord will give it liberally to those that request it. But here is the kicker: you have to be pre-ordained. Not ordained as a minister, but you have to be that spirit that started from the womb. That had to be your lot from the beginning. If you are not pre-ordained, predestined or foreknown, as the scripture says, it is going to be an issue with obtaining the wisdom, retaining the wisdom, or applying the wisdom. Those who are pre-ordained, the elect of God, are going to obtain the wisdom, retain the wisdom and apply the wisdom.

And that was a point of wisdom also to know whose gift she was. So now not only is the Lord dealing with those who have or need or desire the wisdom, but God is dealing with wisdom itself. God is now saying to wisdom, whomever I give you to, I am giving them a gift. So wisdom now understands this is not for everybody.
She knoweth the subtilties of speeches and can expound dark sentences: when Moses says one thing he means something more, and so do Isaiah and Jeremiah.
To conjecture aright what is to come is from what the Bible says, not making things up the way the nation-salvation doctrine does.
